description: Update one of your products. Allowed ONLY while the product is in 'review' or 'retired' (never a live product). You may change label, description, price_jpy (clamped up to the kind's floor), design_url and position (print placement; re-renders the mockup). Printful ids can never change. Owner-only. Requires `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>`.

design_url.description: New absolute https URL to the design artwork.

position.description: Optional print placement — front-print DTG apparel only (tee / tee_white / hoodie / crewneck / tank / long_sleeve_tee). The preview mockup AND the real print order use the same resolved box (WYSIWYG). Preview with mu_preview_mockup before creating.

w_pct.description: Print width as % of the printable area (20-100). 62 ≈ the default chest print.

x_pct.description: Horizontal position of the print box (0=left, 50=centered, 100=right).

y_pct.description: Vertical position of the print box (0=top/neck, 50=centered, 100=bottom/hem).

price_jpy.description: New retail price in JPY (clamped up to the kind's price_floor_jpy).

sku.description: SKU of the product to update (must belong to one of your stores).

name: mu_update_product
title: Update an MU product
